newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rizal Commercial Bank to set US$75 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Rizal Commercial Bank to set US$75 mln FRN.

text.p: Rizal Commercial Bank is expected to launch a US$75 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue into general syndication next week, bankers said.
They said the facility has two tranches.
Tranche A has an issue size of US$25 million and a final maturity of three years. It will pay a coupon of around 70 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Tranche B has an issue size of US$50 million and a final maturity of five years. Its coupon is expected to be between 80 and 90 basis points over LIBOR, bankers said.
Sanwa International Finance and Standard Chartered Bank are the arrangers.
